text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Sang jat faai lok aa! Happy birthday,Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I handed my present over to your<n>classmate. I told
them I was simply<n>returning something I borrowed,
but I<n>promise it's actually a present.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uh... But... Oh, no, it's nothing. Never<n>mind...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy! Let's hear what's on<n>your mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm probably just overthinking it,<n>but... I kind of
thought you were hiding<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You're always so bold. That's why...<n>it seemed a
little strange for you to be<n>so quiet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, you don't like making a big fuss<n>out of things,
right? So I kept that in<n>mind for your present.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a translated novel I recommend. I<n>read it in the
original language and<n>learned so much!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're so intelligent, so I know you'll<n>like it. I'd
love to talk about our<n>impressions after too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Er... Thanks. Um, so... I'll tell you<n>when I read it...
maybe... No, I will... I'll<n>tell you.
